subject: MidasBank: request for remediation closure records and VM proof
messages:
From: Andrew Liu <andrew.liu@midasbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@midasbank.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Request: remediation evidence for SIG/VM section

Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. MidasBank is working through the SIG questionnaire and the security team asked us to provide concrete evidence for vulnerability management controls (scan cadence, ticket -> patch timelines, CVE remediation attestations). They specifically requested: 

- Last three authenticated host/infra scan results and a short summary of critical/important findings.
- A mapping of open CVEs (if any) with assigned owners and expected close dates.
- Proof that critical/high CVEs are closed within our SLA (30 days) — audit-ready artifacts preferred (scan exports, patch records, change approvals).
- A short attestation letter from your security ops describing cadence and escalation path.

I attached the SIG request PDF with the exact fields they need (file: Midas_SIG_Req_20261119.pdf). Can you confirm what you can share and an ETA?

Andrew
Andrew Liu
Sr. InfoSec Manager, MidasBank
security@midasbank.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: andrew.liu@midasbank.com
Date: 2026-11-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request: remediation evidence for SIG/VM section

Team — please help assemble a small, audit-ready packet for MidasBank. They want scan exports and an attestation for SIG. Specific ask below and who I'm assigning: 

1) Scan exports (last 3 infra scans) + a 1-paragraph summary of critical/important findings and whether they're open/closed — Marissa, you own this. Please include Snyk/Qualys export and a flattened CSV of the criticals.

2) Patch/Change evidence for closed CVEs in the last 90 days — include change IDs, patch window timestamps, and who approved the change. Marissa, include the patch_window_log_202611.csv stub.

3) Attestation letter describing cadence (weekly authenticated scans, monthly third-party scan, SLA for criticals = 30 days) and the escalation flow to infra + engineering leads — Soojin, can you draft this attestation and sign as Director, InfoSec Ops?

4) Quick mapping of any open CVEs with owner and target close date — Laura, can you run the current tracker and produce a 1-line per CVE map?

Timeline: can we have a completed packet by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-24)? I'll perform a final review and send to Andrew. If any items can't be shared, flag here with reason (sensitive or redacted).

Attachments: action_items.md (internal checklist).

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request: remediation evidence for SIG/VM section

Karthik / team — attaching the exports you asked for. See notes inline.

Attachments:
- snyk_criticals_20261119.csv (export of critical/high findings from 2026-11-19 authenticated scan)
- patch_window_log_202611.csv (change IDs and timestamps for November patch windows)

Notes: 
- Of the 18 critical/high findings in the Snyk export, 15 were remediated within 30 days; 3 are pending backport work (owner assigned, ETA 2026-12-05). Rows in the CSV include "cve_id, component, severity, status, assigned_to, remediation_ticket".
- Patch log contains change IDs (CHG-4319, CHG-4338, CHG-4390) with approve timestamps and post-deploy verification notes.
- Redactions: for customer-facing deliverables, we redact internal IPs and exact hostnames (we'll provide a mapping summary instead).

If you want a consolidated single PDF for Midas, I can flatten these into a short summary + attach the raw CSVs.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: andrew.liu@midasbank.com
Cc: security@midasbank.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-24T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request: remediation evidence for SIG/VM section

Andrew — please find our consolidated response below and attached (remediation_attestation_20261124.pdf). The packet includes: 

- Snyk export summary (last three authenticated scans) and CSV of critical/high findings (snyk_criticals_20261119.csv).
- Change window and patch evidence for November (patch_window_log_202611.csv) with change IDs and post-deploy checks.
- Remediation attestation (attached PDF) describing cadence and escalation path.
- Drive folder with raw exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMIDAS_VM_PROOF (read-only link).

Key points (audit summary):
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated infra scans, monthly external scan by third-party.
- SLA: critical/high CVEs triaged within 48 hours and remediated or mitigated within 30 days; this has been met for 83% of cases in the last 90 days. Exceptions are tracked and have documented owners (3 items outstanding; owners and ETAs included in the CSV).
- Evidence: all remediation tickets include change IDs, approver, deploy timestamp, and verification notes. We have redacted hostnames/IPs in the copy provided for privacy; mapping can be shared under NDA if needed.

Please let us know if you need a single PDF with redacted artifacts or if the CSVs are fine for your SIG reviewer. If additional attestation (signed by VP of Ops) is required, flag and we'll route for exec sign-off; otherwise Soojin has signed the attached attestation as Director, InfoSec Ops.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
